2026-10-11 01:09:10.705166 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:

2026-10-11 01:09:10.708014 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.

2026-10-11 01:09:10.708027 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-10-11 01:09:10.708033 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-10-11 01:09:10.708038 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
2026-10-11 01:09:10.708044 | controller | • In case of template units, the unit is meant to be enabled with some
2026-10-11 01:09:10.708050 | controller |   instance name specified.
